mode: self-hosted server, fresh isolated Docker instance, REST, one agent_id namespace (adebench-eval); adapter by Dakera's founder
door: POST /v1/memory/recall {agent_id: "adebench-eval", query, top_k: 8, session_id}; the adapter's reference reader composes the text: cards, dated facts, episodes, working memory, an unknown-terms path
results: top_k 8 (adapter's choice; Dakera's default not stated); facts under score 0.12 dropped when one scores 0.5 or more; at most 5 facts; cut at 2400 characters (chat door)
embeddings: local models (model and dimensions not stated)
not_default: DAKERA_CE31_MAX_SENTENCES=0 and DAKERA_BATCH_SENTENCE_DECOMP=0 (recall-time sentence decomposition, on by default, crowds recall on a small set and makes it non-deterministic); DAKERA_STORAGE=memory, DAKERA_AUTH_ENABLED=false, DAKERA_TIERED=1 (fresh, isolated instance for the benchmark)
